key_decisions.decision: Bind this public verse to Hebrew 1:18 and retain the paired houses.
Bind Hebrew 2:1 and preserve all three workforce figures.
Keep all three tree terms and the joint workforce, continuing the purpose into the next verse.
Preserve all four equal quantities, distinct measures, and the difficult beaten-wheat description.
Retain the craftsman’s name-title and distinguish him from the king.
Keep Dan rather than harmonizing Kings and preserve the full skills inventory.
Keep the counted population and exact total without presenting the labor as voluntary.
Retain every assignment and the coercive force of making the people work.
